Bilbao, 21/07/2021

The Basque Research and Technology Alliance (BRTA) held its first meeting of the new 2021-2023 Board of Directors on Wednesday 21 July. The meeting was held by videoconference.

BRTA's 2021-2023 Board of Directors is made up of 16 members, 8 of which are appointed by the Basque Government, and 8 by the research centres that make up the BRTA.
